title: They get the job done, but this is not the best bang for your buck...
text: They get the job done, but this is not the best bang for your buck.... Holds your sodas perfectly. For double stacking, you can have 5 cans at the bottom, and 4 at the top. One of the stock photos show 7 cans at the bottom, but I believe those are smaller thinner cans. It gets the job done, but we'll have to knock 2 stars for not being price competitive. A quick search on Amazon, and you'll find a set of FOUR for even less. This brand is a bit overpriced. 3-Stars.
